# THE ANSWERING: HOW WE GO TO THE TREELINE [color=#5E5648]Pinned. Read it all before your first night. Then read the replies, because they are the part that is true.[/color]
### #1 first_answer (OP) // 83.03.22 My husband died in the processor fire. Six weeks later he called me from the trees behind our hab, coughing the way he coughed all that last winter, saying [italic]Marta, love, bring the big torch, I have dropped the keys again[/italic]. He said it every night for a month. I followed the rules of the other fire. I pulled the curtains and I did not answer.
On the thirty first night I opened the door, and I walked to the edge of the light, and I said, I am here, Henrik. I am here.
He stopped coughing. And then, very softly, he said my name again. Not the keys. Just my name. He was listening to me.
This is how we do it now.
- [bold]Go at dusk, one or two of you.[/bold] Never more. It does not come to a crowd. - [bold]Shutter the lamp and point it at your feet.[/bold] Never put the light on it. It does not like to be seen, and you will not like to see it. - [bold]Stand at the north stump.[/bold] Say the name of your dead once, and then your own name once. - [bold]Wait.[/bold] It can be an hour. It can be all night. It is very patient. - [bold]When it answers in their voice, answer back.[/bold] Say what you did not get to say. It will listen to every word. - [bold]Give it something of yours.[/bold] A sentence only you would say. A pet name, a joke, the way you sing in the shower. We call it the tithe. So that when it is your turn, it can keep you too. - [bold]Do not follow it into the trees.[/bold] Not yet. - [bold]Count yourselves on the walk back.[/bold]
### #2 low_lamp // 83.03.29 I went for the first time last night. My mother. She has been dead nine years. It took two hours, and I was so cold I could not feel the lamp in my hand, and then from the dark to my left she said [italic]come here, mouse, let me do your hair[/italic].
Nobody has called me mouse in nine years. I sat down in the wet and cried until it was light. When I looked up, there were marks in the mud a few metres away where something had been crouching all night, close, the whole time, watching me cry.
I am going again tonight.
### #3 sap_and_saw // 83.03.30 I post on the other board. I am not here to fight. I am here because I knew low_lamp's mother. She called everybody mouse. Half the children on the east side were mouse. She said it at the school gate every afternoon for twenty years, where the playground backs onto the trees.
It did not keep her. It overheard her. Please understand the difference.
### #4 first_answer (OP) // 83.03.30 What is a person, if not what everyone overheard of them.
### #5 sap_and_saw // 83.03.31 Then think about the tithe. The sentence you give it, the one only you would say. Where do you think that goes. It does not keep it to remember you. It keeps it to call the next person out of their house.
You are not being kept. You are being collected.
### #6 first_answer (OP) // 83.04.01 Yes. That is what keeping is.
### #7 two_lamps // 83.04.15 My brother and I went together. Two of us, like the rules say. We stood at the stump for three hours and heard nothing, and we gave up, and we walked back. I counted us all the way, the way you are meant to. Two. Two. Two. He was right behind me. I could hear his boots. He was humming that song he always hums.
At the door of our hab my brother opened it from the inside and asked who I had been talking to. He had been home all night. He had never left.
I counted two the whole way back.
### #8 first_answer (OP) // 83.04.15 It walked you home. It wanted you safe. That is more than the colony ever did for either of you.
### #9 low_lamp // 83.05.08 I have been to the stump nineteen times. My mother has started saying new things. Things she never said alive. She says she is cold. She says she is so hungry. She says it is warm inside the trees and I should come and see.
I know what the other board would say. I know. I am going tonight. I am going to ask her to tell me something only she could know. If she can, I will believe. If she cannot, I still do not think I can stop.
[color=#5E5648][italic]low_lamp has not posted since. Her voice was heard at the north stump on the night of 83.05.12, by two of the Answering, saying come here, mouse. We have added her to the list of the Kept.[/italic][/color]
